- Development and release: feature and bug-fix PRs, verification, version tags, and GitHub "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"velopment and release: feature and bug-fix PRs, verification, version tags, and GitHub pre-releases."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin requires the DSH `llm` and `credentials` services; the Web settings page also uses `setti"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ngs`, and the usage overlay additionally needs the browser carrier `connection` (without it the plug"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"in runs normally and simply registers no balance route).
